# Code Span Spaces

Extra space after backtick content: `` `x`  ``.

An escaped backtick is not code: \`  not code  `.

A single leading space: ` x`.

A single trailing space: `y `.

Padding around a backtick: ``  b`c  ``.

A space separating a backtick is allowed: `` `a ``.

Symmetric single padding is allowed: ` code `.
